p: Glenmore Business Park is on the eastern edge of Chichester, near the A27, which means you're close to some of West Sussex's biggest draws without having to tackle the city centre traffic.

Just north of the city, the Goodwood estate hosts the world-famous Festival of Speed and the Goodwood Revival, when fast cars and vintage style take over the area. If your visit coincides with one of these, expect very busy roads, but also a real buzz in the air.

Aviation fans will want to stop at Tangmere Military Aviation Museum, a short hop east of the business park, where you can see aircraft and learn about the history of the RAF airfield that once stood here.

In the city, Pallant House Gallery is a lovely spot for modern British art, and the Chichester Festival Theatre is known for its high-quality shows, including family productions during the holidays. The ornate Market Cross, right in the centre, is a handy meeting point and a good photo stop.

For a breath of country air, the Weald and Downland Living Museum at Singleton is an open-air museum of rescued historic buildings, with farm animals, crafts and plenty of space to explore. Out towards the harbour, the pretty village of Bosham is famous for its waterside church and the tide that floods the road, so check the tides before you park.
With so much on the doorstep, a session at Flip Out fits nicely into a full and varied day out in this corner of Sussex.
